category_title: African American male students sharing community and family roles
scenario_title: Sharing a personal neighborhood video and job rejection
minimal_context: The student is sharing a video he recorded on an iPod about his life outside of school with his teacher.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Let's watch the video you recorded on the iPod about your life outside of school.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Presses play on the iPod) This is my typical afternoon. I rode the bus to the grocery store for breakfast foods, and then I took a bike ride through my neighborhood to visit my grandmother.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Here is the layout of my house. I just cut the grass today. A little plant, a little tree, flowers. I do this up myself. And inside, I am a big wrestling fan. I really like to watch wrestling. I like to play wrestling video games.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright. What is the next part of the video?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: This church is where my dad works. He gives—well, he works as the deacon. And we don’t really go to church that much. I play for the basketball team. I tried to get a job there cleaning it up… but they said no, and pay them more.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Let's watch the video you recorded on the iPod about your life outside of school.

STUDENT: (Presses play on the iPod) This is my typical afternoon. I rode the bus to the grocery store for breakfast foods, and then I took a bike ride through my neighborhood to visit my grandmother.

TUTOR: Okay, keep playing the video.

STUDENT: Here is the layout of my house. I just cut the grass today. A little plant, a little tree, flowers. I do this up myself. And inside, I am a big wrestling fan. I really like to watch wrestling. I like to play wrestling video games.

TUTOR: Alright. What is the next part of the video?

STUDENT: This church is where my dad works. He gives—well, he works as the deacon. And we don’t really go to church that much. I play for the basketball team. I tried to get a job there cleaning it up… but they said no, and pay them more.
